propositions: When structured parse retries exhaust OUTPUT_RETRIES in _pai_structured prompted branch, the raw reply is discarded and the failure cannot be replayed for diagnosis

New config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (default None, resolved via LLMConfig._llm_str) enables opt-in local artifact capture on final parse failure, writing reply text, model id, contract name, and attempt count to a timestamped file before raising the error
Artifact write is best-effort and never masks the original parse error; directory is created on demand and at most 20 artifacts are retained per directory by mtime-based rotation

The key is resolved in LLMConfig.from_env using the standard CLI > env > file > default precedence and environment variable REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR, following the existing _llm_str pattern for other llm.* knobs
Successful parses and unset key result in zero behavior change; the artifact hook only fires immediately before raise last on final retry exhaustion in the prompted branch
